channel.title: AI Unfiltered
channel.description: Chinese AI • Open Source • Security • Incidents. Signal, not noise.

item.title: Chinese Researchers Show Noninvasive Ultrasound BCI; 13 of 24 Patients Improve in Early Study
item.description: A noninvasive ultrasound brain-computer interface from SIAT and partners was shown in Shenzhen. In an early study, 13 of 24 patients with chronic disorders of consciousness improved.

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Publishes Hy-Nomas Technical Report and Releases Hy-Nomas-Bench for World Models
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan detailed Hy-Nomas, an open 8B interactive video world model driven by text and camera inputs, and released Hy-Nomas-Bench, a 280-case benchmark for world models.

item.title: Huawei Says It Will Not Make Drugs, Aims to Be the Computing Base for AI Drug Discovery
item.description: The head of Huawei's pharmaceutical business unit says Huawei will not develop drugs or pipelines. It wants to supply computing, storage, networking and tools for AI drug discovery.

item.title: AgiBot Unveils GO-3 Preview Robot Model, Tops Three Leaderboards and Plans Open Source
item.description: AgiBot's GO-3 Preview embodied model uses a WRAM architecture, tops RoboDojo, RoboTwin and RoboColiseum, and is set to be fully open-sourced by the end of 2026.

item.title: Doubao Work Opens Kimi, GLM and DeepSeek Models to Team and Enterprise Customers
item.description: ByteDance's Doubao Work now offers third-party models, starting with Kimi K3.1 Pro, GLM-5.3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, to team and enterprise plans, billed from existing AI credits.

item.title: Can Frontier Models See Past a Decoy? Elorian Tests Visual Reasoning
item.description: A new decoy counting benchmark exposes a gap between seeing and reasoning. Elorian’s Glimpse tries to bridge it by thinking with images.

item.title: Google Touts Powerful Cybersecurity Capabilities in Gemini 4 Carbon Model
item.description: Google’s new frontier model scored 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro and is rolling out first to vetted cyber defenders via its Fairwind Program. The post Google Touts Powerful Cybersecurity Capabilities in Gemini 4 Carbon Model appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: How Secure Are US Elections? Voting Machine Risks and the Growing Threat of AI
item.description: Unpatched voting machines, unverifiable QR-coded ballots, and AI-driven influence campaigns leave US elections short of secure. The post How Secure Are US Elections? Voting Machine Risks and the Growing Threat of AI appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Cisco Open Sources Quarry to Catch AI Agent Attacks Hidden in Harmless Steps
item.description: Cisco open sourced Project Quarry, a rule language for detecting AI agent attacks that only emerge across sequences of benign actions. The post Cisco Open Sources Quarry to Catch AI Agent Attacks Hidden in Harmless Steps appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Adobe, Veeam, Juniper Networks Patch Critical Vulnerabilities
item.description: The flaws could lead to arbitrary code execution, authorization bypasses, and privilege escalation. The post Adobe, Veeam, Juniper Networks Patch Critical Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.
